the disorder in the lattice causes a shift of the infrared lattice vibration to lower frequencies.
the lattice vibration of LiF and CaF2 are shifted to shorter wavenumbers by disorder and that the shift is more pronounced in LiF than in CaF2.

the disorder of LiF and LiFl+20%KF films is increased by condensation at low temperatures and that the infrared lattice vibration of the films is shifted to longer wave lengths.
